newsitem.title: USA: China's Qian due in U.S. on Sunday.
newsitem.headline: China's Qian due in U.S. on Sunday.

text.p: Chinese Foreign Minsiter Qian Qichen is due in the United States on Sunday for talks with government officials, U.S. officials said on Tuesday.
They said he was expected to arrive in New York on Sunday and to hold talks in Washington Monday through Wednesday.
Qian's visit was announced last week by Secretary of State Madeleine Albright, although the dates were not made public at that time.
He is expected to meet President Bill Clinton, Albright and other senior officials.
The relationship between Washington and Beijing is intensifying ahead of a proposed summit later this year between Clinton and Chinese President Jiang Zemin.
